overall_notes: This paper primarily focuses on evaluating the quality and characteristics of synthetic data (paraphrased social media posts) for hate speech detection, rather than evaluating NLG outputs per se. However, it does involve generation (paraphrasing) and human evaluation of the generated outputs, so it qualifies as NLG evaluation research. The automatic metrics (F1) are used to evaluate classifiers trained on the synthetic data, not directly to evaluate the generated text quality.
